purpose: Explainable prose-pattern linting. Findings describe review signals, not authorship.

patterns.label: Tier-1 vocabulary
patterns.suggestion: Replace the inflated word with the concrete fact, action, or consequence.

patterns.label: Significance inflation
patterns.suggestion: State what happened and let the evidence establish its importance.

patterns.label: Filler phrase
values: it is important to note that
at the end of the day
patterns.suggestion: Delete the setup or use the shorter direct construction.

patterns.label: Copula avoidance
patterns.suggestion: Use is, has, or the precise action when it is clearer.

patterns.label: Superficial -ing tail
patterns.suggestion: Remove the tail or turn it into a supported independent claim.

patterns.label: Negative parallelism
patterns.suggestion: State the positive claim directly and keep only a necessary contrast.

patterns.label: Rhetorical question and answer
values: \b(?:the result|the reason|the answer|why does this matter)\?\s+\S
patterns.suggestion: State the answer directly unless the reader would genuinely ask the question.

patterns.label: False suspense
patterns.suggestion: Deliver the information without a drumroll.

patterns.label: Fake-candid opener
patterns.suggestion: Remove the staged pause and state the point.

patterns.label: Objection nobody raised
values: \b(?:some might (?:say|argue)|you could argue|don't get me wrong|i'm not (?:saying|arguing)|to be clear)\b
patterns.suggestion: Keep a sourced or developed objection; otherwise state the claim directly.

patterns.label: Rejected fake alternative
values: \b(?:a tempting (?:option|approach)|one might be tempted|you might think|it would be easy to)\b
patterns.suggestion: Remove the abandoned drafting option and explain the real constraint.

patterns.label: Dramatic colon reveal
values: \b(?:the best part|the key|the detail|the result|the twist):\s+[a-z]
patterns.suggestion: Rewrite the reveal as a direct sentence.

patterns.label: False agency
patterns.suggestion: Name the person, team, system, or event responsible for the action.

patterns.label: Formulaic saying
patterns.suggestion: Replace the saying with the specific mechanism or consequence.

patterns.label: Vague attribution
patterns.suggestion: Name and cite the source, own the opinion, or remove the claim.

patterns.label: Stacked hedges
patterns.suggestion: Keep the one qualifier that represents real uncertainty.

patterns.label: Prompt echo or announcement
values: here's what you need to know
patterns.suggestion: Begin with the subject instead of announcing the document.

patterns.label: Chatbot artifact
values: let me know if you'd like
patterns.suggestion: Remove assistant scaffolding from the deliverable.

patterns.label: Knowledge-limit disclaimer
values: as of my last training update
patterns.suggestion: State what is known, identify the source boundary, or omit the unsupported passage.

patterns.label: Generic concluding uplift
patterns.suggestion: End on the last supported fact, consequence, choice, or next action.

patterns.label: Decorative formatting
patterns.suggestion: Use formatting only when it helps the destination and reader scan the content.

patterns.label: Dash cluster
patterns.suggestion: Keep a demonstrated dash habit, but replace decorative clusters with ordinary punctuation.
